ENCODED = ''
from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time,zlib
repo=Path('/disk/10tb/home/shmelev/gnnm_iclr_validation_tuning/postsubmission_git')
phase=repo/'experiments_iclr/postsubmission_20260930'
assert Path.cwd()==repo and os.uname().nodename=='peptide'
root=phase/'ncnc_completed_prediction_decision_diagnostic_20261005_v1';root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
rows=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(ENCODED,validate=True)))
for row in rows:
 assert '/' not in row['name'] and row['name'].endswith(('.json','.py'))
 data=base64.b64decode(row['data'],validate=True);assert len(data)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 with (root/row['name']).open('xb') as stream:stream.write(data)
command=['/disk/10tb/home/shmelev/miniconda3/envs/rapids-25.06/bin/python3.12','-B',str(root/'diagnose_saved.py')]
environment=dict(os.environ,CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='',OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',MKL_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='2',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
wall=time.perf_counter()
try:
 done=subprocess.run(command,cwd=repo,env=environment,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
 result=dict(status='CPU_ATTEMPT_RETURNED',exit_code=done.returncode,stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(done.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),stderr=done.stderr,outer_wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-wall,automatic_retry=False)
 try:result['result']=json.loads(done.stdout)
 except json.JSONDecodeError:result['stdout_text']=done.stdout
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
 result=dict(status='CPU_ATTEMPT_TIMED_OUT_NO_RETRY',outer_wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-wall,automatic_retry=False,error=str(error))
with (root/'PHYSICAL_CPU_RESULT.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(result,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False))
